scope: independent root audit of the all-prime-power degree criterion, residue implication, de-overlap, support cutoff, exact-one counterexamples, asymptotic capacity, dependency pins, and deterministic replay

checks.root_repairs: Promoted canonical paths/status, pinned the audited Item415 and Item418 packages, updated the strategic ceiling to Item418, and completed the q>6m defect check for both adjacent rows rather than displaying only K_0.

mathematical_audit.tower_divisor: For q=p^e, quotient/remainder decomposition gives omega_s=F_s^q P_s dx with deg P_s=d_q. If d_q<=q-2, C^e(P_s dx)=0; iterated Cartier preserves simple residues up to Frobenius, so the corresponding exact log residue vanishes modulo p. Separate levels may be used for the two coordinates.
mathematical_audit.large_level_exclusion: If q>6m, then d_q(N,K_0)=3q-3 and d_q(N,K_1)=3q-6, both greater than q-2 for odd q. Thus all qualifying witnesses may be restricted to q<=6m.
mathematical_audit.deoverlap: Removing the first-level Item200 set P_m leaves E_m. Every p in E_m needs exponent e>=2 in at least one row, hence p<=sqrt(6m). Multiplying distinct congruences gives the squarefree divisor F_m E_m of both residue coordinates.
mathematical_audit.zero_rate: The crude support estimate log E_m<=sqrt(6m) log sqrt(6m)=o(m) is uniform. Dividing by E_m therefore changes finite carriers but not any normalized exponential ceiling.
mathematical_audit.nested_levels: Once C^e(omega)=0, every later Cartier iterate is zero. These are nested characteristic-p statements and cannot be counted as independent p-adic digits.
mathematical_audit.counterexamples: Exact reconstruction gives common valuation one at (m,p)=(2,11), at the Item149-overlap row (9,13), and at the genuine higher-level row (5,5), where q=25 qualifies but q=5 does not. Thus neither F_m^2 divisibility nor one digit per prime-power level is uniform.
mathematical_audit.current_ceiling: Combining the zero-rate E_m normalization with canonical Item418 leaves the strictly-large component ceiling 0.4287738853386578689... unchanged.
